thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: primary-west1 GPU queue > 95% (avg queue length 214). Autoscaler attempted new allocations but hit max_replicas. Triggered at 2026-03-15T10:03:09Z

mia: Ack. I'm oncall for eng-sre. Paging now.

nick_oncall: On it. quick check: any global spillover happened automatically?

incident-bot: Routing policy: primary->fallback enabled. Spillover attempted to eu1 but 70% of requests were rejected due to model-variant mismatch (variant v1.3 -> v1.2 fallback). Logs: 503s from router.

ash: We're seeing autoscaler logs: "scale_loop: desired 48 > max_replicas (40) -> refusing scale". Also observed cloud quota errors: "insufficient quota: GPUs (p100)" in west1.

ops-lex: Confirming quota shortage. We had a budgeted reserved pool and it was fully allocated by long-running batch jobs in west1. Those were supposed to be preemptible but didn't evict.

elaine_support: Support reports enterprise customers A20 and Kora seeing increased 5xx and latency spikes ~10:03->10:10. Tickets coming in. SLA risk.

jordan: Quick mitigations: 1) enable overflow-route to eu1 for compatible variants, 2) relax strict variant matching in router for short window, 3) bump autoscale max_replicas temporarily. Which one first?

mia: Do 1 and 3 in parallel. Enable overflow-route + set max_replicas=60, then drain long-running batch jobs in west1. I'll coordinate with infra.

nick_oncall: I'll run the config change. Command: 
```sh
# enable overflow route for primary-west1
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://control-plane/api/v1/routing/overflows -d '{"from":"west1","to":"eu1","allow_variant_relax":false,"ttl_sec":900}'
```

deploy-bot: Config change queued: routing/overflows create -> id rflow-2334. Pending approval.

ash: While that's pending, autoscaler bump: 
```sh
# patch autoscaler max
kubectl -n inference patch hpa inference-west1 -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":60}}' --type=merge
```
Result: patched, new max 60. Autoscaler now attempts scale -> cloud quota fails for 14 GPUs.

ops-lex: Quota still blocking. I'm requesting emergency quota increase with cloud provider (support case 99877). ETA ~20-30m.

mia: Start manual spillover for critical tenants only. Update routing rule to allow variant relaxation for enterprise customers.

nick_oncall: Executed relaxation for priority_customer_tags ["enterprise", "platinum"] -> enable. Router shows 1xx -> 2xx handoffs to eu1 but 30% of sessions still failing due to session affinity on old KV caches.

jordan: We can evict prefix caches for those sessions. Command: 
```sh
# flush prefix cache for tenant Kora
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://control-plane/api/v1/cache/flush -d '{"tenant":"kora","prefix":"/kv"}'
```

ops-lex: Doing eviction now.

incident-bot: routing/overflows rflow-2334 activated at 2026-03-15T10:06:12Z. Approx 5200 req/s diverted to eu1.

elaine_support: Support update: after diversion, error rate for Kora dropped from 12% -> 3%. A20 still seeing occasional 503s while sessions migrate. Continuing to triage.

ash: We still have degraded throughput because eu1 has lower per-GPU throughput for this model variant (int8 quant). Latency for diverted requests increased ~120ms median. Not ideal but acceptable per SLA for now.

mia: Summarize for handoff: primary-west1 GPU pool saturated due to unexpected non-preemptible batch jobs + autoscaler hit configured max_replicas and cloud quota limit. Router initially rejected spillover due to strict variant matching -> after relaxation and cache eviction we achieved partial recovery. Current actions: 1) overflow-route active 10:06->, 2) autoscaler max increased to 60 (still waiting on quota), 3) cloud quota request in flight, 4) evicted offending batch jobs (ops) -> started draining.

nick_oncall: I'll take next 2-hour oncall. Current status: traffic at ~70% normal, error rates back to ~2-4% for most tenants, enterprise retries enabled, monitoring alarms silenced but we'll keep watch. Oncall notes: follow-up to coordinate permanent autoscale policy and enforce preemption on batch jobs.

jordan: Added short-term mitigations to runbook: turn on overflow route earlier, allow relaxed variant matching for priority traffic, preempt batch jobs older than 15m when queue > 80%.

elaine_support: I posted customer-facing note in #support-status. CC'ing account owners for A20/Kora.

mia: Leaving a bullet list for postmortem: timeline, why batch jobs didn't preempt, autoscaler max was too low for traffic shape, routing variant strictness prevented immediate spillover, cache affinity blocked some session migration, cloud quota contingency missing. Action owners assigned.

ops-lex: Cloud provider updated quota to +20 GPUs at 10:23 (case 99877 closed). Autoscaler completed scale to 58 by 10:28. Back to steady state.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: primary-west1 queue < 40% at 2026-03-15T10:28:59Z. All high-sev alerts cleared.

nick_oncall: Final handoff note: I'll create a short incident doc in #postmortems and assign owners. Mia, tag me if you want to coauthor. Leaving this thread active for further notes.

mia: Thanks everyone. Paging clear for now. :thumbsup:

jordan: follow-ups: 1) ensure autoscaler maxReplicas auto-increase heuristic, 2) enforce preemptible label on long batch jobs, 3) add variant fallthrough test to chaos suite.

elaine_support: Logging action: created support tickets and sent proactive outreach to A20/Kora. They confirmed mitigation was fine and will keep monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident closed to paging at 2026-03-15T10:35:00Z. Postmortem scheduled for 2026-03-16T16:00 UTC.
